jobs.description:
As an Operator in Hot Kitchen Department, you are responsible for independently operating various production machines. In this department, ingredients and prepared products are fried, cooked, steamed, mixed, and boiled.

Your responsibilities include operating equipment such as cooking kettles, filling machines, mixers, and combi steam ovens. You also prepare dishes and food components in accordance with our quality, hygiene, and safety standards.

 

What does the job involve?

As a Kitchen Operator, you are the right-hand person of the Team Leader in the Hot Kitchen Department, supporting them in the production of prepared dishes and food components.

You are responsible for preparing and carrying out recipes. Your tasks include:

• Taking over the duties of kitchen staff in their absence.

• Carrying out the necessary quality checks on raw materials and preparing them for processing when required. Depending on the workload, you work together with kitchen staff, providing them with clear instructions and guidance to ensure that their tasks are carried out correctly.

• Independently following and executing recipes in accordance with quality standards and IFS requirements.

• Ensuring that industrial equipment is properly cleaned after and between each production run, in accordance with hygiene regulations.

• Preparing spice blends according to the recipes when the Goods Receiving employee is absent.

• Correctly preparing frozen ingredients and recipe components according to the production order.

• Labelling semi-finished products and recording their use in our computer system.

• Recording cooling temperatures.

Requirements:

• You have a very good command of Dutch (speaking, reading, writing, and understanding). A good knowledge of English and/or French is an advantage.

• You are comfortable with basic calculations, reading weights, and using weighing scales.

• You have completed training in a culinary field (institutional catering, chef, catering assistant, or butcher) or have equivalent experience.

• You are familiar with food safety regulations.

• You are able to operate a manual pallet truck.

• You are flexible and enjoy the challenge of switching between different departments.

• You can work well under pressure. Things can get quite busy at Marblo! 

• You maintain a neat and well-groomed appearance. For hygiene and safety reasons, gel nails, excessive make-up, visible piercings, etc., are not permitted in our production areas.

For a company in the Tielt region, active in the food industry, we are looking for a motivated and reliable Packaging Operator.

Your responsibilities:

• Operating and monitoring packaging machines and equipment.

• Preparing products for the packaging process.

• You like working with vegetables

• Checking the quality of packaged products.

• Monitoring the packaging and production process.

• Solving minor machine issues and reporting technical problems to the supervisor.

• Keeping the workplace clean and organized.

• Following all safety, hygiene, and quality procedures.

 

 

Your profile:

• Experience in production or machine operation is an advantage.

• Willingness to work during the day

• Reliable, accurate and motivated.

• Able to work independently as well as part of a team.

• Good work ethic and a responsible attitude.

• Besides Polish or Romanian of other language,  you also  have a good knowledge of English

Are you a skilled welder with an eye for detail and a passion for metalworking? Then we have a great opportunity for you!

Jobomschrijving

As a welder, you will be responsible for accurately assembling and welding a variety of metal constructions based on technical drawings and specifications. You play an important role in delivering high-quality end products and actively contribute to maintaining craftsmanship and reliability.

You will work closely with your colleagues to ensure projects are completed efficiently and within set deadlines. In addition, you act as a representative of the organization in contacts with clients and partners.

·        Experience in welding, preferably semi-automatic (TIG is a strong plus)

·        Accuracy and a strong focus on quality

·        Flexibility and the ability to work under pressure

·        Team spirit and a positive work attitude

·        A professional and presentable appearance

·        Proficiency in Dutch or English

·        Willingness to learn and further develop your skills

As Lead Full Stack Developer, you take a key role in the further development and evolution of a suite of business-critical applications used in real-time operational environments.You remain strongly hands-on in both backend and frontend development, working primarily with .NET and Angular, while also guiding technical choices, improving existing implementations and helping shape upcoming solutions. You challenge current approaches where needed and translate complex technical topics into clear and pragmatic proposals.A major part of the role is technical leadership. You support and coach other developers, promote knowledge sharing and help maintain high standards in code quality, maintainability and software design. You work closely with analysts, architects, testers and other developers within an Agile/Scrum setup.You also keep a close eye on delivery, scope and technical risks. When dependencies, architectural concerns or implementation issues arise, you identify them early and help the team move towards a robust and sustainable solution.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience in .NET & Angular
• +15 years of experience in IT
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French

You will implement new features and improve existing modules within a modern frontend stack where performance, reliability, and usability are key.You will also support the team with your technical expertise in Angular, helping maintain high standards in code quality, maintainability, and reusability. You will collaborate closely with backend engineers, UX specialists, and product stakeholders in an Agile/Scrum environment to deliver robust and scalable enterprise applications.

Our client is a large Belgian organization with an extensive and business-critical IT environment. Within the infrastructure department, work is being done on various strategic programs concerning hybrid cloud, middleware, integration platforms, networking, and cybersecurity.To further structure multiple infrastructure projects and interdependencies, they are seeking an experienced IT Infrastructure Project Manager who takes ownership of planning, stakeholders, and delivery within the domains of AppStack, Network Security, and Networking.
Jobomschrijving
Here, you assume end-to-end management of multiple complex infrastructure projects within a hybrid enterprise environment.You coordinate projects related to middleware, integration, automation, networking, and network security, ensuring that technical teams and vendors remain aligned. You translate the various project lines into concrete plans, milestones, and deliverables, and closely monitor these using tools including MS Project and Jira.You guide technical teams during implementations, migrations, and infrastructure changes, while monitoring schedules, scope, budget, resources, risks, and dependencies.You organize alignment and synchronization meetings, maintain coherence between different initiatives, and ensure transparent communication with stakeholders and management.Additionally, you oversee governance, documentation, compliance, and security requirements.

•  5y experience as Project Manager in IT-infra
• You are strong in stakeholder management and diplomacy
• Broad technical knowledge of infrastructure, cloud, middleware, integration, and security 
• Trilingual environment (English, Dutch & French): you should at least understand (not speak) them at a basic level and master one
